text: After the landings `intent claude skills sync` has run on this machine, announced to every vc first, the install carries no culled skill, and the fleet sweep after the cut is noted as what carries the templates to the estates.

state.evidence: vc, 2026-10-25 18:47Z on rhadamanth: announced at 18:43Z to molt-vc, utilz-vc, devbin-vc, laksa-vc, conflab-vc and gtools-vc, all six answering no hold; intent claude skills sync updated ten skills and skills uninstall removed the eight culled (in-standards, in-cost-analysis, in-debug, the five in-tca-*), leaving fifteen canon skills and a sync dry run settled; subagents sync updated the six critics and subagents uninstall removed intent. The fleet sweep that carries the new root templates to each estate is each estate's intent claude upgrade --apply (--skip-settings where it keeps its own settings), run by that estate's vc, at the latest in the fleet sweep after the cut.
